referents.why: 'me' in the imperative 'honor yourself over me' is the first person of Moses, the sender of the turn.
second masculine singular 'for you' inside Moses's speech: the addressee is Pharaoh (turn addressee w4).
second masculine singular possessor 'your officials' in Moses's speech: Pharaoh, the addressee.
referents.category: second person possessor inside a speech

referents.why: second masculine singular possessor 'your people' in Moses's speech: Pharaoh.
referents.category: second person possessor inside a speech

referents.why: second masculine singular 'from you' in Moses's speech: Pharaoh.
second masculine singular possessor 'your houses' in Moses's speech: Pharaoh.
referents.category: second person possessor inside a speech

referents.why: the implied subject of the imperative 'honor yourself' is the one the command is spoken to: Pharaoh.
first person singular 'I will pray' is Moses, speaking in his own turn.
feminine plural 'they will remain' agrees only with frogs (w24, feminine plural); the Nile is where they remain.
referents.category: third person plural of a feminine noun

links.why: lamed plus infinitive construct after the yiqtol 'will I pray' gives what the praying is for, cutting off the frogs. 'Pray' is not one of the verbs that take a completing infinitive.
links.category: infinitive of purpose after a request

links.why: 'he said' introduces Moses's speech; cl1 is the first said clause. The rest of the speech (cl2, cl4) stays in the turn as parts; the content link does not replace the turn.
cl5 names no clause of this verse (its clauses are cl0 to cl4), and an and-then link does not run across verses.
links.category: link to a clause outside this verse

groups.why: Moses speaks to Pharaoh; the command, the question and the exception clause are all his words, so they are parts of his turn.

none_fit.where: cl4 (only in the River they will remain)
none_fit.what: An exception to the request ('except for those in the Nile'). No link type reads a restriction by exception: unless is the cancelling exception, and but_rather is a correction. Kept only as a part of the turn, unlinked.
